turn.user_message: What would the trial look like?

text: Start with a two-week trial on one ward, beginning with the consultants who decide latest, because they gain the most.
It needs no new staff and no new system. It turns our biggest guess, the hours saved on each discharge, into a measured fact.
chat.pointer: The three steps run in order, and the page ends with two ways to go on.
chat.note: Prove it on one ward, then decide on the rest.
prompts: Walk me through the daily automation
I’d need to check with my team
